image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black hockey puck resting on a white, textured fabric surface (likely a towel or cloth). The puck features a prominent circular logo on its top face with red and white graphics and text. The side of the puck shows horizontal ridges. There is a distinct, somewhat irregular shadow cast to the left, and a strange, flat, black extension or 'tail' protruding from the right side of the puck, which appears structurally inconsistent with a standard puck.
